question: Does the saved 2016-2022 f696 development allocation plus b472 predecision cap provide cross-year legal target support for a bounded cash-to-SOXL opening receiver, including the cap-binding layer?
parent_boundary: Exact f696 development_walk_forward raw proposals and same-date b472 predecision training-frame cap; this is not a full OOF b472 action or own-state funded candidate account.

fixed_rule.population: All 1756 one-to-one f696 development_walk_forward and b472 training-frame signal dates in 2016-2022; validate all three proposal weights and unchanged legal projection against saved b472 targets. Load only predecision columns; no future outcome or action-value labels.
fixed_rule.ceiling: Saved cap+0.10 beta on binding dates, unchanged saved cap otherwise. This is a diagnostic legal-target envelope, not an approved risk policy.
fixed_rule.target: projected_SOXL+delta_beta/3, projected_SOXX, projected_cash-delta_beta/3; assert sum1, SOXL<=0.30, cash>=0.15 and target_beta<=ceiling. Positive support requires delta_beta>1e-10.
fixed_rule.report: All 1756 dates; binding and nonbinding support; each calendar year and total support; no outcome-defined date selection. Do not infer whole-share fill, net local value, or funded SOXX result.

support_gate: At least 100 positive-support dates overall and at least three calendar years with at least 20 each, matching the prior source-support floor. This only allows a separately frozen information/label experiment, not a candidate account.
stop: Stop on changed source summary/artifact/projector hash, missing NAS receipt/readback, non-FINISHED source recorder, nonidentical 1756 dates/raw weights, Qlib calendar mismatch, unchanged-control projection error >1e-8, or illegal diagnostic target. If support fails, close this fixed arm without altering delta, cap, asset, support floor or years.
